diagnosis: The smart building access subscription streams real-time physical badge entry and exit events (employee names, card badge IDs, timestamps, and granted/denied statuses) based solely on client-supplied facilityId. The server does not verify if the requesting user is an authorized security operator or tenant of that commercial building, exposing physical tracking and movement patterns of personnel across private facilities.
